hack.root_cause: Read-only reentrancy on Curve LP token virtual price — inflated collateral valuation
hack.description: Midas Capital lost $660K when an attacker exploited a known read-only reentrancy bug in Curve LP tokens to inflate collateral value and overborrow jFIAT assets — a vulnerability that had already struck market.xyz three months earlier.
